title: Minuta 2026-09-24
summary: The minutes of the 24 September meeting record a unanimous 5-0 hold at 6.50%, but the member-by-member discussion is clearly more dovish than the decision: three of the five members now openly float a cut at coming meetings ('se podrá evaluar una disminución puntual', 'podría llegar a valorar la posibilidad de una disminución', 'existen elementos para discutir... un ajuste fino a la baja'), conditional on core continuing to fall and orderly markets. The majority still sees the balance of risks to inflation tilted to the upside (energy shock, sticky services above 4%, expectations nearer 4% than 3%), and one member stays firmly hawkish, wanting the stance held 'por un tiempo prolongado' and even raising a possible coupling with the Fed's hiking cycle; a fifth member asks for caution and a hold. Collectively the Board decouples from the Fed's hike, saying policy need not react mechanically to fed funds adjustments, and frames the remaining restriction as close to diluted. Versus the previous minutes (Minuta 2026-08-06), where no member advocated cuts and the guidance was to keep the rate at its current level, the Board moves from comfortable hold to hold with the easing question open: -1.0.

key_quotes.quote: en las siguientes decisiones se podrá evaluar una disminución puntual en la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: One member opens the door to a one-off cut at coming meetings, conditional on determinants continuing to support disinflation

key_quotes.quote: existen elementos para discutir la conveniencia de realizar un ajuste fino a la baja de la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Another member argues that ignoring slack would mean more restriction than needed; a fine downward adjustment should be discussed, not pre-decided

key_quotes.quote: La mayoría consideró que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: The majority keeps the upside tilt to the inflation risk balance -- the main brake on the dovish shift

key_quotes.quote: la postura monetaria debe mantenerse en los niveles actuales por un tiempo prolongado.
key_quotes.context: The lone hawk wants a prolonged hold and warns a coupling with Fed hikes may need discussing if inflation does not converge
